items.title: 67520_George Handy oral history interview
items.q: I had an appointment with Paul Weston and Jo Stafford

ctx.x: (Side A of Tape 4 ended at this point. Transcript will continue in accordance with Side B.)

--I had an appointment with Paul Weston and Jo Stafford, for some reason and we were having dinner in the Club Morocco, the band was playing; they were about to do an air shot and Boyd came over to the table and he said, 'do me a favor. Dodo was roaring drunk and he's about to fall off the piano chair. Would you play the air shot with us?' And I excused myself and I went out and played with them one more time to do that air shot. The night Dodo was drunk.
That was the last night you played on the band?
